correctness.rationale: For f=x^3y+y^3z+z^3x, f and all partials have no common projective zero. Independent F2 sparse symbolic multiplication verifies exact homogeneous degree-18 identity G(grad f)=fQ, with Q=x^14+y^14+z^14+x^8 y^4 z^2+x^4 y^2 z^8+x^2 y^8 z^4. Singular equations of G in A=1 chart imply B=t,C=t^5,t^21=1; imposing G=0 forces t^7=1. The mixed second derivative is C^4≠0, giving seven ordinary nodes. A reduced sextic split 2+4 or 3+3 would require >=8 intersections, contradicting seven simple nodes; a line factor requires >=5 collinear nodes, while exact F8 incidence gives at most three. Thus irreducible and equals one-dimensional Gauss image. Arithmetic genus10-7=3. Pullback Gauss hyperplane has degree12, dual degree6 -> degree2 over normalization; separability would contradict genus3 Riemann-Hurwitz, so purely inseparable and identifies normalization with Frobenius twist. The two branches of each node are two tangent points, exhausting geometric bitangents. Independent F8 coordinate computation checked 7 nodes and each of 21 node pairs lies on a line with exactly 3 nodes. The field-independent geometry follows from the algebraic arguments, not F8 enumeration.
